subject: Media Literacy
title: Propaganda vs. Education
description: A micro-lesson that makes Propaganda vs. Education usable.

hook.text: North Korea's textbooks teach that Kim Jong-il invented the hamburger. That's propaganda, not education.

buildup.text: Both education and propaganda transmit ideas, but their methods and intentions differ sharply.

discovery.text: Education invites critical thinking. Propaganda demands acceptance without question.

twist.text: The line blurs when governments design school curricula to promote national narratives as fact.

climax.text: Every country teaches a version of history that flatters itself. The question is how much it distorts.

quiz.question: What is the key difference between education and propaganda?
options: Education invites critical thinking while propaganda demands acceptance
